title: Card Relationship Levels That Narrow the Claimed Total on a Personal Checking Claim
content:
Two cases narrow the foreign card items that make up the claimed total on a Personal Checking claim, both read from the owner's card payments under Personal Credit Cards and from the account's own posted items.

**First case.** Where the owner has made at least 6 card payments in the last twelve months and a foreign card item stands on the account, only the foreign card items posted inside the claim window make up the claimed total. The claim window runs back 2 calendar months from the day the matter is handled.

**Second case.** Where the case above does not apply and either the owner has made at least 3 card payments in the last twelve months or a foreign card item stands inside the claim window, only the largest single foreign card item makes up the claimed total.

**Otherwise.** Where neither case applies, the claimed total is not narrowed in either of these ways.

**Worked narrowing on hypothetical inputs.** An account carries foreign card items of 200.00 and 3.00 posted inside the claim window and one of 120.00 posted seven months ago.

| Owner's position | Claimed total |
|---|---|
| 7 card payments in the last twelve months, foreign card items standing | 203.00, being the items inside the claim window |
| 4 card payments in the last twelve months | 200.00, being the largest single item |
| 1 card payment, a foreign card item standing inside the claim window | 200.00 |
| 1 card payment, no foreign card item inside the claim window | Neither case applies |

The first case requires both of its limbs; the second is met by either limb alone. Equality satisfies each threshold, so exactly 6 card payments with a foreign card item standing reaches the first case and exactly 3 reaches the card limb of the second.
